OPEN, NO KNOWN MITIGATION (carried into the plan as stated limitations, not backlog items): motion feel cannot be judged while editing because the editor runtime fights the site runtime; sibling-anchored free positioning is unprototyped; bundler byte-reproducibility is unestablished by any consulted source and its fallback weakens the export proof; the generation-channel output ceiling is unknown and its published figures are unreliable; same-uid file-mode enforcement is a speed bump, not a boundary; free position cannot degrade gracefully for compositions that depend on absolute cross-viewport relationships.

SEQUENCING RISK (recorded, mitigated by ordering not by solution): the binding scope decision front-loads the highest-risk unproven mechanic (the canvas) before the pipeline around it is proven. The mitigation is that the blocking turn-boundary gate and the whole phase-zero spike suite precede canvas work, and that the canvas epic is sub-sliced so it can be stopped at any sub-slice boundary with an explicit trade-back-out order.
